build_GenericRoIExtractor: build a GenericRoIExtractor with sum aggregation to extract RoI features from multi-level feature maps
build_GenericRoIExtractor_concat: build a GenericRoIExtractor with concat aggregation to concatenate RoI features from multiple feature map levels
build_GenericRoIExtractor_with_pre_post: build a GenericRoIExtractor with pre and post processing modules for RoI feature extraction
forward_GenericRoIExtractor: forward multi-level feature maps and RoIs through the GenericRoIExtractor to extract aggregated RoI features
forward_GenericRoIExtractor_with_scale: forward feature maps and RoIs with a scale factor to rescale RoIs before extraction
